answer: Each identity must complete one voyage per epoch and file the result in the haven ledger: a key-bound task drawn from the epoch seed, posted in time. A 25-credit pearl bond backs every identity, and a voyage counts only for its signing key and its own epoch. The k-th fake identity needs a voyage and bond, so 1,000 fakes cost 25,000 credits plus 1,000 voyages per epoch, linear with no reuse. A rented-voyage ring fails because a voyage under another key does not match the buyer, and auditors rechecking the ledger burn a reused bond. An honest agent completes one voyage and keeps its bond.
